subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public TTS delivery policy that lets Telegram users choose separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live under global `messages.tts` or channel/account-scoped TTS config?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the fix adds public config and overlaps with captioned-final and voice-only TTS behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests covering current captioned behavior, explicit separate text-plus-voice behavior, overflow fallback, and Telegram failure fallback.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery as product direction
options.body: Decline the separate selector and document tagged/manual workarounds plus caption overflow behavior instead.

options.title: Wait for captioned-final resolution
options.body: Keep this open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83511 settle the related Telegram TTS direction.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests covering current captioned behavior, explicit separate text-plus-voice behavior, overflow fallback, and Telegram failure fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current config/schema and Telegram caption-delivery history most consistently route this product-contract decision to steipete.
